mode: target-domain normal-only adaptation, not zero-shot cross-dataset transfer

VID-AD.training_protocol: one model per scenario, pooled capture conditions; every method uses identical source partitions
VID-AD.split: official train indices 0:10+30:40 training;15:20+40:45 development;20:25+45:50 calibration;10:15+25:30 embargo; official test unchanged
VID-AD.grouping: configuration-balanced consecutive frame-index blocks, held together across all capture conditions; five-frame guard sections retained; source video/instance independence remains unverified
VID-AD.known_limitation: Raw video/physical-instance identifiers are not supplied. No claim of verified video-instance-independent generalization.

measurement_annotations: 20 training (indices3,35,37,39 across5conditions) and15 development (19,41,43 across5conditions) weak normal boxes per VID scenario; additional normal-only annotation frames requested after balancing
baseline_training: SALAD final70000 steps; LogiCo final200epochs, no test-selected checkpoint; all receive the same frozen pixel-predicted component maps
additional_comparison: ComAD shared-component-map adaptation and PUAD official scorer with shared independently optimized EfficientAD branch; AnomalyMoE frozen transfer optional
threshold: strict score > normal calibration 95th percentile, higher; no test optimization
retrospective: Earlier independent Qwen experiment already viewed these benchmark images; this is not a blind new benchmark.
